item.title: Cummins Recalls Portable Generators Due to Risk of Serious Injury from Fire and Burn Hazards
item.company: Sold At: Camping World, Factory Pure, Northern Tool, AP Electric stores and online atCummins.com from May 2025 through August 2026 for between $1,640 and $1,930.
item.brand: Sold At: Camping World, Factory Pure, Northern Tool, AP Electric stores and online atCummins.com from May 2025 through August 2026 for between $1,640 and $1,930.
item.product: Cummins Onan P5000iDF EFI Dual Fuel Portable Generators
item.summary: This recall involves the Cummins Onan P5000iDF EFI Dual Fuel Portable Generators sold in a dark gray color. The generators can operate on gasoline or propane, and produce between 4,500 and 5,000 watts, depending on fuel. “Cummins” is printed in white on the front of the unit and the handle above the control panel. The Cummins "C" logo and "Onan P5000iDF EFI" are printed on the side. The model and part number can be found on the label attached to the side of the generator.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Cummins Onan P5000iDF EFI Dual Fuel Portable Generators.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the recalled portable generators immediately and go to https://www.cummins.com/en-na/na/generators/portable-generators/safety-recalls/campaigns/7308 to check if the model and part number is included in the recall. If your unit is affected, contact an authorized Cummins service location and arrange for a free repair at the service location. To find a service location near you, please use the Service Locator link at https://quickserve.cummins.com.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
